cells.gaps: No source found shows Law No. 5 of 2022 used: no arrest, charge or conviction under it. A comprehensive cybersecurity bill is in preparation (LBY-001, LBY-003).
cells.note: Cabinet Decision 358 of 15 July 2026 cites Law No. 5 of 2022 on combating cybercrime among its legal bases and lists it as in force (LBY-004), so a law is in force. No use of it is held, so not stage 4.
